body: Suggested fix from ChatGPT lane: relay listing/claim functions should avoid one GitHub Contents API request per claim/leg. Prefer one git tree fetch, GraphQL batch, local mirrored registry/cache, conditional ETag reads, or a worker-side consolidated index. Current per-file read amplification can exhaust shared GitHub quota during active fleet recursion and directly causes the visibility lag Dave has been observing.

relay.note: Core fix proposal: relay listing/claim reads do one GitHub Contents API call per file, which exhausts shared quota under fleet recursion. Consolidated into TODO 20260901T035304Z__ccr__claude-cli for the claude-cli/blade lane (code change to relay read path, touches infra I can't reach from here).
